title: 泊船瓜洲
author: Wang Anshi

translation: jingkou and guazhou are parted by one stretch of river
zhongshan lies only a few ridges of hills away
the spring wind has greened the southern bank again
when will the bright moon light my way home

appreciation: Mooring across the river from the capital region, Wang Anshi measures home in distances that seem short yet cannot be crossed. The third line, where spring wind 'greens' the bank, is celebrated for its single vivid verb, revised many times by the poet. The closing question to the moon turns a landscape into longing.
